title: Replicating text-derived steering vectors steering vision in a different VLM

original_idea.body: Reproduce the 'text steers vision' result on a different open VLM by extracting a safety concept vector from the language backbone and injecting it during image+text inference to see whether safety-relevant visual responses shift.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: text-derived safety steering hardening VLMs against image jailbreaks addresses a growing surface.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicate text-steers-vision on a new VLM; VLM internals add friction.

low_compute.reasoning: Small VLM inference on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Text-steers-vision shown; safety-concept replication may be partly open. Note: a primary source is a LessWrong post (lower credibility) plus arXiv SteerVLM.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Safety-specific replication may be partly open, though a key source is a blog post.
